description: Water content percentages for common baking ingredients. Used by the experiment tool to calculate effective hydration, inclusion moisture load, and derived baker's percentages when ingredient amounts change.
sources: Prof Steven Abbott — Water Content for Baking (stevenabbott.co.uk)
Bread, Cakes and Ale — The Hydration of Enriched Doughs
King Arthur Baking — Hydration in Bread Dough
USDA AMS — Nonfat Dry Milk Grades and Standards

items.name: All-Purpose Flour
items.note: USDA FDC #168894. Varies 10-14% with storage humidity.

items.name: Bread Flour
items.note: USDA FDC #168890. Higher protein, similar moisture to AP.

items.name: Whole Wheat Flour
items.note: USDA FDC #168896. Bran absorbs more water during mixing.

items.name: Rye Flour (dark)
items.note: USDA FDC #168900. Pentosans in rye absorb 6-8x their weight in water.

items.name: Cornstarch
items.note: USDA FDC #169690.

items.name: Whole Milk
items.note: USDA FDC #746776. Standard 3.25% milkfat.

items.name: Buttermilk
items.note: USDA FDC #170099. Cultured, low-fat.

items.name: Heavy Cream
items.note: USDA FDC #170856. 36%+ milkfat.

items.name: Sour Cream
items.note: USDA FDC #171258. Regular (not light/fat-free).

items.name: Yogurt (plain, whole milk)
items.note: USDA FDC #171284. Greek yogurt is lower (~79%).

items.name: Cream Cheese
items.note: USDA FDC #173417. FDA max moisture 55%.

items.name: Nonfat Milk Powder
items.note: USDA AMS standard: max 4.0% moisture (spray process).

items.name: Mozzarella (whole milk)
items.note: USDA AMS spec: max 52% moisture for whole-milk mozzarella.

items.name: Mozzarella (low-moisture, part-skim)
items.note: USDA FDC #170845. Max 52% per AMS spec.

items.name: Mozzarella (fresh)
items.note: Fresh mozzarella in brine. Highly variable (55-65%).

items.name: Cheddar Cheese
items.note: USDA FDC #173414. Sharp/extra-sharp may be slightly lower.

items.name: Parmesan (Parmigiano-Reggiano)
items.note: USDA FDC #170848. Hard aged cheese, lowest moisture in category.

items.name: Gruyere
items.note: USDA FDC #173410.

items.name: Feta
items.note: USDA FDC #173420. Brined soft cheese.

items.name: Ricotta (whole milk)
items.note: USDA FDC #173422. Very high moisture — significant hydration contributor.

items.name: Whole Egg (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #171287. ~50g per large egg without shell.

items.name: Egg White (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #171288. ~33g per large egg white.

items.name: Egg Yolk (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #172185. ~17g per large egg yolk.

items.name: Butter (unsalted)
items.note: US standard ~80% fat, 16% water, 4% milk solids. European butter (82%+ fat) has ~15% water.

items.name: Olive Oil
items.note: Trace moisture only (~0.1%). Treated as 0% for hydration math.

items.name: Vegetable/Neutral Oil
items.note: Canola, sunflower, safflower — all effectively 0% water.

items.name: Lard
items.note: Rendered fat, effectively 0% water.

items.name: Shortening
items.note: Hydrogenated fat, 0% water.

items.name: Granulated Sugar
items.note: Dry crystal, effectively 0% moisture. Hygroscopic in high humidity but negligible for hydration math.

items.name: Brown Sugar (packed)
items.note: USDA FDC #168833. Molasses coating adds slight moisture.

items.name: Confectioners' Sugar
items.note: Contains 2-5% cornstarch as anti-caking agent. Negligible moisture.

items.name: Honey
items.note: USDA FDC #169640. Legal max 20% in US. Despite being liquid, low water activity due to sugar concentration.

items.name: Maple Syrup
items.note: USDA FDC #168890. Higher water than honey.

items.name: Molasses
items.note: USDA FDC #168861. Blackstrap is slightly lower (~19%).

items.name: Corn Syrup (light)
items.note: USDA FDC #168852.

items.name: Jalapeño Pepper (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #172574. Very high water — major moisture contributor in inclusion breads.

items.name: Jalapeño Pepper (pickled)
items.note: Estimated. Must drain and squeeze thoroughly if subbing for fresh.

items.name: Onion (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #170000. Caramelized onions lose ~75% of original water.

items.name: Garlic (raw)
items.note: USDA FDC #169230. Lower moisture than most fresh vegetables.

items.name: Roasted Garlic
items.note: Estimated. Roasting drives off moisture but adds paste-like consistency.

items.name: Sun-Dried Tomatoes
items.note: USDA FDC #172435. Oil-packed add fat, not water.

items.name: Carrot (raw, shredded)
items.note: USDA FDC #170393. Relevant for carrot cake.

items.name: Pepperoni
items.note: USDA FDC #174571. Cured/dried sausage, relatively low moisture.

items.name: Bacon (cooked, crisp)
items.note: Estimated from USDA cooked bacon data. Raw bacon is ~42% water.

items.name: Green Olives (brined)
items.note: USDA FDC #169094. Drain weight; brine adds sodium.

items.name: Kalamata Olives
items.note: Estimated from ripe olive data. Oil-cured/brined.

items.name: Walnuts
items.note: USDA FDC #170187. Dried/processed kernels.

items.name: Pecans
items.note: USDA FDC #170182.

items.name: Almonds
items.note: USDA FDC #170567. Blanched/slivered similar.

items.name: Sesame Seeds
items.note: USDA FDC #170150. Topping only; negligible hydration impact.

items.name: Pumpkin Seeds (pepitas)
items.note: USDA FDC #170556.

items.name: Raisins
items.note: USDA FDC #168165. Seedless. Can absorb water if soaked.

items.name: Dried Cranberries
items.note: USDA data. Sweetened (Craisins-style).

items.name: Dried Apricots
items.note: USDA FDC #168146. Higher moisture than most dried fruit.

items.name: Dates (Medjool)
items.note: USDA FDC #168191. Deglet Nour dates are drier (~20%).

items.name: Sourdough Starter (100% hydration)
items.note: Derived: 50% flour (12% water) + 50% water (100%). Effective water contribution = 50% of weight + flour moisture. Simplified to 46% for practical use.

items.name: Instant Yeast
items.note: Approximate. Negligible contribution at typical usage (1-2% of flour).

items.name: Baking Powder
items.note: Approximate. Sub-gram usage makes moisture irrelevant.

items.name: Baking Soda
items.note: Anhydrous sodium bicarbonate.

items.name: Salt (fine sea salt)
items.note: Dry crystal. Negligible moisture.

items.name: Dark Chocolate (60-70%)
items.note: Approximate. Fat-based; effectively dry for hydration math.

items.name: Chocolate Chips
items.note: Same as bar chocolate. Stabilizers add no moisture.

items.name: Cocoa Powder (unsweetened)
items.note: USDA FDC #169593. Absorbs liquid in dough.

items.name: Water
items.note: The baseline. All other ingredients are measured relative to this.

items.name: Lemon Juice
items.note: USDA FDC #167747. Fresh squeezed.

items.name: Vanilla Extract
items.note: Approximate. ~35% alcohol + water. Sub-tablespoon usage makes this negligible.

items.name: Beer
items.note: Approximate for standard lager/ale.
